title: [Task Sprint] QA Testing Report — Panorra PWA

issues.main_description_html:
QA Summary - 2026-08-24

Scope and Verdict

Item Result
Feature Add Collection Zard UI
Environment Dev (dev.panorra.com)
Verdict Passed
Test data Authenticated tester account with real public posts
Persistent test data Temporary Dev collections were created during the approved test flow and may be removed manually.

Test Results

ID Test Method Scenario Expected Result Actual Result Status
TC-01 Black-box Open Add Collection with an authenticated account Composer renders with name input, post grid, tabs, and disabled Save state All controls rendered correctly with Zard UI Passed
TC-02 Black-box Enter a valid collection name and select one public post Save becomes available only when required inputs are present Save became enabled after one post selection Passed
TC-03 Gray-box Submit the enabled form UI feedback corresponds to a successful create request POST /collection-post returned HTTP 200 and the UI showed “Collection created successfully!” Passed
TC-04 Black-box Deselect the selected post Save returns to its guarded disabled state Selection state returned to zero and the create guard remained active Passed

Code Review

Area Review Result
UI architecture Standalone Angular component with OnPush change detection and Zard UI input/button components
State handling Signal-based selection state and computed selected-slug set
Validation Collection name requires 2-50 characters; creation requires at least one selected post
API mapping Selected public post slugs are mapped to collection_posts; thumbnail fallback is provided from the last selected post
Empty state The UI provides an explicit no-posts state and prevents invalid submission

Test Method Coverage

Method Coverage Result
Black-box Visible composer flow, guard states, selection, success feedback Passed
Gray-box Browser network observation connected UI submission to the collection-create endpoint Passed
White-box Component validation, signal selection logic, API payload mapping, and Zard UI composition Passed
Confusion matrix Not applicable: the feature has no binary classifier or decision model N/A

Evidence Notes

The recording was captured on the dedicated QA browser on display 2. The Dev address bar/domain is visible, and the video was validated as a playable 41-second MP4 before publication.
